scripts.format: prettier --write src index.html package.json tsconfig.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json tests/frontend.test.mjs tests/ui.test.mjs
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src index.html package.json tsconfig.json src-tauri/tauri.conf.json tests/frontend.test.mjs tests/ui.test.mjs
scripts.test:peers: cargo build -p harness-sync-native --bin harness-sync-fixture-peer && node scripts/native-peer-e2e.mjs
scripts.test:ui: cargo build --locked -p harness-sync-native --bin harness-sync-fixture-peer && node --test tests/ui.test.mjs
